t.E1200.agn: In 2021 EFSA found no genotoxicity concern; no adverse effects were seen at the highest doses in long-term, reproductive and developmental studies. It saw no need for a numerical ADI and concluded that there was no safety concern at the reported uses.
t.E1200.body: Polydextrose is absorbed to a limited extent; part of it is fermented into short-chain fatty acids in the large intestine.
t.E1200.found.0: Table-top sweeteners in powder and tablet form
t.E1200.found.2: Carrier in additive, enzyme and nutrient preparations
t.E1200.prod: Produced by polymerising glucose through condensation with small amounts of sorbitol and citric acid.
t.E1200.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern at the reported uses.
t.E1200.summary: A bulking agent synthesised from glucose that has the properties of a soluble fibre. It adds volume in low-sugar and low-calorie products.
t.E1200.what: A low-energy bulking agent that adds volume; it can be used to replace sugar.
